Most unfortunate.''"<br />"''Not for those in possession of his few masterpieces.|[[Darish Vol]], and Abeloth|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
Master '''Dekta Amon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], recognized for his exceptional [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]] craftmanship. In [[44 ABY]], Amon disappeared, after he created several exquisite and unique hoversleds for [[Abeloth]]'s [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] welcome celebration.
